office_does: The three county commissioners are Benton County's legislative authority, setting county taxes and budgets; District 2 voters nominate, and the whole county elects, the District 2 commissioner (RCW 36.32.040).
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Michael Alvarez (Prefers Republican Party), board chair and former Richland mayor, is the only candidate. He was nominated by District 2 voters in August, and all Benton County voters elect him in November.

candidates.summary: Benton County Commissioner since 2023 and board chair, former Richland mayor and council member; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Commissioner since Jan. 2023 and board chair; Richland City Council 2018-2022, including as mayor [S1][S2]
Pledges no unnecessary tax increases and cites millions in taxpayer savings [S1][S3]
Wants a mental health and substance abuse treatment facility without raising taxes or fees [S3]
